paragraphs.text: The Colekgan Mountains were a large mountainous region in the northwestern Terisiare on Dominaria .

The city walls of distant Terisia City were of white stone hauled from the Colekgans by dwarves and their giant slaves. It was here that Ashnod triggered an avalanche that caused her to capture a fleeing Loran carrying the Golgothian Sylex .
The Colekgans lasted into the Dark Age , and at that point contained the minotaurs of Urhaalan Valley and the elves of Eln Forest.
During the Ice Age , the Ohran Ridge was the only accessible part of the mountains. After the Thaw , the Colekgans became known as the Ohran Mountains and are part of Gulmany .
